Fnosk, aka "Charlie", "Big Pappi", "F-Nozzle", "Fnorris" and "All-Star Running Back Feronte Jones" is an old-school Swedish player. He is officially retired from QW but there are strong rumours linking him with a return to 4on4 with [[Osams]] for EQL season 13.
